paragraphs.title: Intro
paragraphs.text:
%md
# Hello from the zeppelin CLI
This note was created from `examples/notebooks/hello-shell.json`.

paragraphs.title: Generate data
paragraphs.text:
%sh
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do echo "row,$i,$((i * i))"; done > /tmp/zeppelin-cli-demo.csv
wc -l /tmp/zeppelin-cli-demo.csv

paragraphs.title: Summarise
paragraphs.text:
%sh
awk -F, '{ s += $3 } END { print "sum of squares:", s }' /tmp/zeppelin-cli-demo.csv
